perfil.escolherHandle: Choose your @name to get a page in the Network.
perfil.selosAjuda: A track badge is declared by the person, from what they did on their own device; the site does not check it.

avatar.enviarAjuda: The photo is shrunk and stripped of camera data (place, date, device) on your device, and the server checks again. Others only see it after moderation accepts it.
avatar.pendente: Waiting for moderation. Only you see this image for now.
avatar.semSuporte: This browser cannot prepare the image. Pick a drawing from the gallery.

editar.entrarNaRede: Join the Network to edit your profile.
editar.handleAjuda: 3 to 20 lowercase letters without accents, digits or _. After the first pick you can change it once every 30 days.
editar.bioAjuda: Up to 160 characters. No real name, phone, e-mail or address.
editar.modoTrancadoAjuda: Whoever wants to follow asks, and you approve. Current followers stay.
editar.modoInvisivelAjuda: Your profile disappears from search, mentions and lists, and no new person can follow.
editar.estudandoAjuda: Shows on your profile the last lesson you opened on this device, for up to 14 days. The site only reads it if you turn it on, and you can turn it off any time.
editar.estudandoNada: No lesson opened on this device yet. Open one and come back.
editar.selosMostrar: Show my badges on the profile
editar.selosSemProgresso: No finished track on this device yet.
editar.fixarAjuda: One of your posts stays at the top of the profile.
editar.semPosts: You have not posted anything yet.

erros.handle_reservado: That @name looks like the institute's or the team's. Pick another.
erros.handle_recente: You changed your @name recently. You can change it again in a few days.
erros.invalido_handle: Use 3 to 20 lowercase letters without accents, digits or _.
erros.invalido_imagem: That image does not work: it must be light and free of camera data. Try another, or pick from the gallery.
erros.invalido_bio: The text did not pass: remove anything offensive or personal.
